notes: Slimez is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints all 1,000,000,000 SLIMEZ once to msg.sender, the deploying factory. It has no transfer fees or administrative powers and no additional minting entry point. No application contracts are included. pool.initialPrice records provenance; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
